svg.title: brand-components
svg.desc: Tadayo implementation design. Text outlined from Arimo; native controls shown schematically.

g.aria-label: Revision 1.1 · Complete replacement · All dimensions in points
Day plaque 45 × 55 · weekday 10/12 bold · day 25/28 bold
Height follows the caption. Only a selected highlight animates.
Long name wraps after the hyphen. No smaller type.
Large text uses a vertical list, 353 wide
96 minimum height; expand for all text. Label 20/26 here.
Every light and dark cover: fill #182B25 · initial #FAFBF8. Never reuse a cover as avatar fill.
50 minimum height · label 16/22 bold · radius 13 · no opacity multiplier
Focus: 2 pt ring, 2 pt canvas gap, 4 pt beyond the control. Only when keyboard focus is visible.
Input border #778579 on canvas or surface; 1 pt minimum.
Opaque label on a photo, both themes: #FAFBF8 / #182B25.
One row after current members. No day assigned; no approval count.
Card status 13/18 · date title 25/29 bold · club header 16/20 bold
+ Add 15/20 bold · primary button 16/22 bold · photo label 11/14 bold
Folded card radius 16 · ticket radius 18 · photo radius 14 · surface radius 12
Profile title and utility headings 32/35 bold; never shrink a long name to fit.
Native TabView selection uses the system filled symbol and a persistent label.
No custom pill, progress ring, applause count or approval leaderboard.
u = 44 of the 915 source units, measured across the lower t stem below the crossbar.
At 144 wide, u = 6.925 pt. Keep at least u clear on every side of the viewBox.
Minimum touch targets 44 × 44. Fold corners and small decorative initials are not separate buttons.
